# #1845: Patch: hidden Nerfs and trade offers
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S18.

## The rule

A Nerf hidden from the card's owner until it is played, never touching its cost (Stinkyscape #123 Gokugains: three Nerfs, thirty on its Radiant face, on a random Unit in the opponent's hand), through `view_for`, the AI's redaction and `determinize`; and a trade offer at the opponent's start of turn: you give a card from your hand, they Discover one of theirs to give you (#77 Yuma).

## Done when

- The rule is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.
- Its §6 row (and §3, §4 or §10 where it touches them), and ruling notes from this issue's block, R(N×1000) up, each named after its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3); `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; a new prompt or action is answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree. Hidden cards never change the AI's decision (`crates/ai`'s rule).
- The client's piece, where the mechanic has one, renders `viewFor` alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4).
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). ## Goal

Two engine primitives, each proved on fixture scripts. No card is added and no shipped game changes.

- **Hidden Nerfs:** `degrade_secretly` puts N Nerfs on a card in a hand or a deck, and nobody sees them:

- [ ] The §6.3 rows, the §10 edits, the three notes, the §11 paragraphs and a regenerated `INDEX.md` are in.
- [ ] There is no new event, so no `ANIMATIONS` or `SOUND_CUES` row is needed; the generated `CardInstance.ts` is kept.
